verdict.rationale: Forter documents its own APIs for order decisions, order-status updates and dispute evidence, plus an official MCP server that lets an AI system review decisions, manage disputes and update policies, which covers several operations normally done in a dashboard. Nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates that everything in the UI is available programmatically, and some configuration is shown only through UI menus (e.g. Site Preferences). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a full API reference covering admin and configuration actions (users, rules, reporting), and independent corroboration of programmatic completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: It enables an AI system to perform real actions—such as reviewing decisions, managing disputes, or updating policies through natural language commands.
Send order information at checkout to receive a fraud or abuse decision.
Inform of updates to the status of an order, including payment authorization, fulfillment, shipping details, and compensation granted.
Save time and effort by using our Evidence API endpoint to automatically send post-order evidence for chargeback disputes.
